Every candidate is health-checked before use: authentica"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"tion and a successful `session/list` call establish a usable connection, and advertised versions bel"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ow the minimum are excluded. External services remain externally owned and are not stopped on discon"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"nect. If authentication credentials are missing, set `dsh.serverUrl` to the full launch URL, includi"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"entication credentials are missing, set `dsh.serverUrl` to the full launch URL, including its token."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Advertisements are discovery metadata only. No advertisement grants or denies permission to start, s"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"o a missing, stale, or unreadable one can never block startup — the worst case is one failed health "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"probe followed by this window launching its own Runtime."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Each window publishes exactly one file, `<ownerId>.json`, under `dsh-runtime-advertisements-<user>` "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"in the OS temporary directory, carrying its endpoint, launch URL, version, PIDs, and composition has"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"h. A window writes only its own file and never reclaims another's; legacy `dsh-runtime.lock` files a"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"re still read as hints, never written or removed. Readers take the sixteen most recent entries, so a"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"n abandoned file cannot crowd out live ones."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Advertisement lifecycle:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- Only a ready endpoint is published. A launch that fails before producing a URL leaves nothing behi"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"nd.
- Startup briefly coordinates through a loopback mutex — at most 250 ms waiting and 500 ms held "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"— and rechecks for a shared Runtime before spawning. Losing that race never blocks a launch; it just"},{"id":"p27s4","text":" means this window starts its own Runtime.
- Explicit stop, dispose, and failed launches withdraw th"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"e advertisement.
- An unexpected launcher exit drops ownership but keeps the advertisement while its"},{"id":"p27s6","text":" endpoint still answers, because package-manager wrappers routinely exit while the Runtime they star"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"ted keeps serving. Only an explicitly refused loopback connection withdraws it; a timeout or an ambi"},{"id":"p27s8","text":"guous host keeps the record.
